title: Study on the structure-activity relationship of watermelon seed antioxidant peptides by using molecular simulations.
authors: Wen, Chaoting; Zhang, Jixian; Zhang, Haihui; Duan, Yuqing; Ma, Haile
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子模拟研究西瓜籽抗氧化肽的结构-活性关系，涉及肽与Keap1蛋白的对接，但对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Our previous studies had shown that watermelon seed antioxidant peptides (WSAPs: P1-P5) possessed good activities. However, the structure-activity relationship of P1 is still unclear. Quantum chemistry and molecular docking were used to investigate the antioxidant mechanism of P1. The active site of P1 is located at C(6)H(14) on Arg. P1 can bind to DPPH/ABTS through hydrogen bond and hydrophobic interaction. Compared with P2-P4, P1 has the strongest antioxidant capacity. The molecular simulation showed that P1 could enhance the stability of Keap1 by interacting with Asn382, Arg380 and Tyr 334 in the active sites. Compared with the model group, the expression of Keap1 was down-regulated (p < 0.05), while the expression of Nrf2 and HO-1 was up-regulated (p < 0.05) after P1 treatment. P1 has the potential ability to activate the signaling pathway Keap1-Nrf2 and improve the antioxidant defense system. This study provides a new perspective for the rational design and mechanism of antioxidant peptides.
abstract_zh: 我们前期的研究表明，西瓜籽抗氧化肽（WSAPs：P1-P5）具有良好的活性。然而，P1的构效关系仍不清楚。本研究采用量子化学和分子对接方法探讨P1的抗氧化机制。P1的活性位点位于Arg上的C(6)H(14)。P1可通过氢键和疏水相互作用与DPPH/ABTS结合。与P2-P4相比，P1具有最强的抗氧化能力。分子模拟显示，P1通过与活性位点中的Asn382、Arg380和Tyr334相互作用，能够增强Keap1的稳定性。与模型组相比，P1处理后Keap1的表达下调（p < 0.05），而Nrf2和HO-1的表达上调（p < 0.05）。P1具有激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路并改善抗氧化防御系统的潜在能力。本研究为抗氧化肽的合理设计和机制提供了新视角。
